summary: Manila 1st District representative with 52 principal-authored bills. Authored a higher 4Ps grant, senior-citizen VAT exemptions and employment, tertiary education subsidy, electricity lifeline-rate expansion, estate tax amnesty and fuel-excise suspension, plus a malicious-AI cybercrime bill; co-authored socialized housing delivery and women-protection bills.
caveat: Tax relief and subsidies mix; the -2 reflects the dominant social-spending pattern. The AI cybercrime bill is a single civil-liberties item and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored higher 4Ps grants (-3), tertiary subsidy (-2), electricity lifeline expansion (-2) and senior VAT exemption (-1); co-authored socialized housing (-2); estate tax amnesty and fuel-excise suspension lean right (+1 net).
